children: Next Hydrogen proposes repaying $450K and extending $1.15M of outstanding debentures from Dec. 12, 2026 to Dec. 12, 2029. The extension is subject to approvals, holder participation and definitive agreements; completion is expected on or about Dec. 12, 2026.
Would defer repayment of most outstanding principal for three years, subject to approvals and holder participation.
Would reduce the $1.60M outstanding principal; no comparison period was provided.
The extension changes maturity only; interest and other material terms remain unchanged.
Completion expected on or about Dec. 12, 2026
The proposal remains conditional on regulatory approvals, holder participation and definitive agreements.

This is a proposed financing-liability restructuring, not a completed transaction, and the release does not report operating results. TSXV and other required approvals, holder participation and execution of definitive agreements would need to follow for the proposal to become a completed catalyst.
from Next Hydrogen Solutions Inc. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
